title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THIRTY THOUSAND DOLLARS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, OUT OF THE GOLD-STANDARD FUND, FOR THE PAYMENT OF INTEREST ON CERTIFICATES OF INDEBTEDNESS ISSUED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS UNDER ACT OF CONGRESS APPROVED MARCH SECOND, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THIRTY THOUSAND DOLLARS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, OUT OF THE GOLD-STANDARD FUND, FOR THE PAYMENT OF INTEREST ON CERTIFICATES OF INDEBTEDNESS ISSUED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS UNDER ACT OF CONGRESS APPROVED MARCH SECOND, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.vi: Luật cấp 30.000 đô la Mỹ từ Quỹ bản vị vàng để trả lãi chứng chỉ nợ do Chính phủ Quần đảo Philippines phát hành theo đạo luật Quốc hội được thông qua ngày 2-3-1903
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรเงิน 30,000 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐจากกองทุนมาตรฐานทองคำเพื่อชำระดอกเบี้ยหนังสือรับรองหนี้ที่รัฐบาลหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์ออกตามกฎหมายรัฐสภาซึ่งอนุมัติเมื่อ 2 มีนาคม 1903
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan 30.000 dolar AS dari Dana Standar Emas untuk membayar bunga surat utang yang diterbitkan Pemerintah Kepulauan Filipina berdasarkan undang-undang Kongres yang disahkan 2 Maret 1903
title.ms: Akta memperuntukkan AS$30,000 daripada Dana Piawaian Emas untuk membayar faedah sijil keberhutangan yang diterbitkan Kerajaan Kepulauan Filipina menurut akta Kongres yang diluluskan pada 2 Mac 1903

text.en:
There is herein appropriated, out of the gold-standard fund, the sum of thirty thousand dollars, in
money of the United States, for the payment of quarterly interest due August first, nineteen hundred and four,
on the certificates of indebtedness amounting to three million dollars, issued and sold on behalf of the Insular
Government by the Secretary of War under authority of the Act of Congress approved March second,
nineteen hundred and three, and Act Numbered One thousand and fifty of the Philippine Commission.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is herein
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on his passage.
Enacted, July 22, 1904.
